prerequisites: Knowledge of Circuit Theory is essential.

Basic notions of Linear Algebra, Differential and Integral Calculus, Numerical Methods, Waves and Electromagnetism, Fundamentals of Computer Science, and especially Electrical Technology are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering aimed at the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacture, installation, assembly or operation of: electronic installations and process automation (Degree in Industrial Electronic and Automatic Engineering), electrical installations (Degree in Electrical Engineering), structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing processes (Degree in Mechanical Engineering).
Ability to manage the activities subject to the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge of basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity and critical reasoning.

Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Electronic and Automatic Engineering (Degree in Industrial Electronic and Automatic Engineering), Electrical Engineering (Degree in Electrical Engineering), Mechanical Engineering (Degree in Mechanical Engineering), Industrial Organization (Degree in Industrial Organization Engineering) both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar works.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan in the field of business, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Ability to prevent occupational risks and protect the health and safety of workers and users.
Honesty, responsibility, ethical commitment and spirit of solidarity.
Ability to work in a team.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of electronics.
Have a general overview of electronics in its different branches and fields of application.
Know the behavior, characteristics and main applications of electronic devices.
Analyze and understand the operation of circuits in which electronic components are present.
Handle datasheets of integrated circuits for analog or digital applications and use some of them in basic assemblies.
Handle laboratory instrumentation and electronic equipment and perform static and temporal measurements in electronic circuits.

syllabus_topics: BLOCK I: BASIC CONCEPTS OF ELECTRONICS
THEME 6: THE IDEAL OPERATIONAL AMPLIFIER. LINEAR AND NON-LINEAR APPLICATIONS.
THEME 7: FUNDAMENTALS OF DIGITAL DESIGN. BOOLEAN ALGEBRA.
THEME 9: DIGITAL INTEGRATED CIRCUITS: LOGIC FAMILIES.
Practice 1 - Handling laboratory equipment (I). Power supply and multimeter.
Practice 2 - Handling laboratory equipment (II). Function generator and oscilloscope.
Practice 6 - Assembly and testing of electronic circuits.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the theoretical block requires a minimum grade of 5.0 out of 10. The practical block also requires a minimum grade of 5.0 out of 10. The final theoretical grade is calculated as (0.35 * T1) + (0.35 * T2) + (0.30 * T3) if all minimums are met. The final practical grade is (P1). The final course grade is (0.9 * Theory) + (0.1 * Practices). If minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical exam (B1, B2, B3 with minimums of 5.0 each) and a practical exam are required; previous notes are not carried over for the theoretical blocks. The final grade calculation is the same as for the ordinary call. If doubt arises about authorship or unauthorized means, a face-to-face defense may be requested.
